About Me

Documentation platform and enablement leader with 13.5+ years of experience driving scalable documentation and customer adoption across complex enterprise software and cybersecurity platforms.

I specialize in building modular, automated documentation ecosystems aligned with product releases, deployment workflows, and customer success outcomes. My work sits at the intersection of documentation strategy, automation, and product enablement.

I collaborate closely with product, engineering, support, and solutions teams to improve usability, onboarding, and self-service success. I actively leverage AI-assisted workflows and code-level analysis to automate documentation tasks, accelerate delivery, and improve technical accuracy.
